title: Spain faces deadly wildfires, at least 12 killed, 19 missing in Andalusia
summary: At least 12 people have died in one of Spain’s deadliest wildfires, with many victims killed while trying to flee the flames by car or on foot in southern Almeria. Sarah Morris reports from Madrid, where authorities say the fire may have started after a power cable fell onto the road and ignited dry vegetation, as firefighters continue to battle the blaze a…
